purpose: Evaluate whether inherited low-I allele access changes future allele-loss and fixation outcomes under altered pollinator service, holding the original R1–R5 evidence grades unchanged.

experimental_allocation.founder_genome_sources: independent freshly generated source axis; count and IDs unchosen
experimental_allocation.visitor_history_sources: independent freshly generated crossed source axis; count and IDs unchosen
experimental_allocation.initial_A_M_treatment: A/M source state must be recorded; genetic fixation is a planned stratum or intervention, not a collider-conditioned automatic exclusion
experimental_allocation.source_state_fork_rule: For each independent founder×visitor×nested demographic source prefix, branch into both predeclared I-access policies; within each policy the two future activity arms start from byte-identical full source PlantState and paired common random streams.
experimental_allocation.access_comparison_caveat: Changing the frequency of a low-I numerical allele usually also changes trait mean, standing heterozygosity and genotype covariances. If using three I alleles to match the mean, variance/support/covariance still change. Declare which are co-manipulated and audit full genomes before inference.

proposed_outcome_contract.unit: founder × visitor-history × nested demographic prefix with matched I-access and activity arms; source axes are crossed, not independent F×V×R islands
proposed_outcome_contract.genealogical_support: At each census retain all N×3×2 diploid alleles and origin identifiers, numerical allele support, population N and ancestry.
proposed_outcome_contract.before_shock_population: Census30 standing low-I numerical allele copies must be positive and below 2N for conditional at-risk estimands; fully fixed/absent source genotypes remain in all-enrolled accounting.
proposed_outcome_contract.first_event_rule: First postfork census at which low-I numerical copies=0; alternatively copies=2N; if N=0 classify extinction with traits undefined; unresolved paths retain polymorphic label at horizon.
proposed_outcome_contract.intention_to_treat_denominator: All allocated crossed-source cells and nested repeats, with initial genotype inaccessibility and extinction explicitly counted.
proposed_outcome_contract.paired_loss_indicators: For proposed conditional at-risk source only, L=1 if low-I is lost by update80 before population extinction; L=0 if it fixes or remains segregating; extinction is a separate competing event, never imputed as no genetic response.

design_only_precision.method: Two-way crossed-source bounded-difference (McDiarmid) confidence-radius illustration, assuming independently sampled founders, independently sampled visitor histories, and conditional independent per-cell demographic streams.
design_only_precision.method_formula: For Y in [−B/2,B/2], two-sided radius h=B*sqrt(log(2/alpha)/2 * (1/F+1/V+1/(F*V*R))). For paired loss risk differences B=2; for access×activity interaction B=4.
design_only_precision.total_model_update_equivalents_formula: F*V*R*(30+2 access levels*2 activity arms*50 future updates). This is a count of proposed state updates, NOT CPU/runtime cost.
